messages:
morgan: Kicking off green-side rollout for router-service now. Pushing v2026-03-20-rc3 to green instances in eu-west1. Change window 21:00-21:30 UTC. plan: smoke -> 1% canary (10m) -> shear weights 25/50/75/100 over 5m steps. rollback thresholds: error_rate>1.5% or p95>700ms.
sanjay: noted. load test script queued. putting brief release notes here: https://redwood.internal/releases/3129998888 (initial).
lia: can you paste the router config snippet for the weight shear? saves me digging.
morgan: sure:
```
route: /api/generate
backends:
  green: 0.01
  blue: 0.99
strategy: weight-shear
steps: [0.01,0.25,0.50,0.75,1.00]
probe: /healthz?probe=canary
metrics: error_rate,p95_latency
```
jamie: deploy-bot, kick it off when we're green ready. tagging the release in LB config: router-tag=router-v2026-03-20-rc3
deploy-bot: @jamie deploy job started: job_id=deploy-3129998888-01. Creating green pool with 6 nodes, prewarming caches, registering healthcheck. ETA ~2m. :rocket:
ops-bot: preflight probes: DNS ok, certs valid, netpolicy ok. KV cache primed.
morgan: starting 1% canary now. pushing green weight to 0.01. will monitor for 10 minutes.
sanjay: kick stress generator at 30s mark. load target ~250 rps across region.
lia: quick note: pinned model variant to 'small-kvcache' on green to avoid OOM while we validate memory paths.
ops-bot: 2m: canary probes healthy. success rate 99.98%, error_rate 0.02%, p95 210ms.
morgan: increasing to 25% (0.25) now. hold 5m. watch for tail latency spike.
sanjay: test harness reports slight increase in 95th at 25% to 420ms, still under threshold. error_rate 0.18%.
jamie: rolling config to add additional drain timeout on blue: drain_timeout=30s to avoid active conn churn.
morgan: bump to 50% (0.5) now. ops, set probe window to 30s to capture short spikes.
ops-bot: 3m into 50%: error_rate 0.22%, p95 680ms. CPU on green nodes steady at ~72%.
lia: saw one 502 cluster on a green host at 50% but it recovered within 10s, root cause likely transient socket exhaustion. will add ephemeral connection caps to next patchpost.
sanjay: still within rollback limits but getting close on p95. recommend slower step to 75% with 10m hold if p95 creeps >700ms.
morgan: agree. altering plan: 50% -> 65% (temporary) -> 80% -> 100%. extend hold at 65% to 10m.
jamie: updating rollout sheet and sending quick note to support channel so CS is aware of potential degraded tails.
deploy-bot: weight update applied: green=0.65, blue=0.35. job_id=deploy-3129998888-01 step=custom.
ops-bot: 5m into 65%: error_rate 0.35% (still <1.5%), p95 730ms (breached p95 threshold). Generated alert in monitoring: alert_id=mon-55642.
morgan: p95 breach noted. how many endpoints affected?
lia: looks concentrated on long sequences >800 tokens; KV cache hit rate dropped due to variant pin. we can toggle cache-mode=aggressive to mitigate but that might increase memory use.
sanjay: immediate mitigations: reduce concurrency per worker by 10% and enable ephemeral socket reuse to lower tail. ops, can you apply concurrency cap to green nodes?
ops-bot: applying concurrency cap=0.9x to green pool now.
jamie: also, start partial rollback plan ready if tail doesn't improve in 3m. No full rollback until 10m of sustained breach.
morgan: agree with staged approach. if p95 stays >700ms for 10m OR error_rate>1.5% we return to blue and mark as rollback.
ops-bot: 2m after cap: p95 down to 620ms, error_rate 0.28%. CPU stable.
sanjay: load generator steady. no error spikes. I'm comfortable continuing to 80% in 5m.
morgan: moving to 80% now. green=0.80.
deploy-bot: weight update applied: green=0.80.
lia: monitoring heatmaps. 80% looks fine. slight p99 blips but no user-facing errors.
morgan: final step to 100% in 5m if no regression. also pinning route header x-release-id:3129998888 for observability.
jamie: send release notes to prod-notify channel at cutover: short bullet list + rollback thresholds + who to contact.
morgan: done: https://redwood.internal/releases/3129998888/notes (short).
ops-bot: final step: 5m hold complete, metrics steady: error_rate 0.21%, p95 580ms. Increasing green to 100%.
deploy-bot: weight update applied: green=1.00. job_id=deploy-3129998888-01 completed. :tada:
morgan: marking this release as success. will run postmortem-lite to capture the transient socket exhaustion and cache tuning. tagging owners: @lia @sanjay.
sanjay: will open issue with workload repro and patch suggestions.
lia: will prepare a follow-up patch to adjust connection pools and consider alternative variant fallback.
jamie: thanks team. putting post-release note in the ops-runbook and closing change window. all good to re-open smoke test window if needed. :white_check_mark:
